隔离调试环境不检查正式更新。: The isolated debug environment does not check production updates.
预览、备注和分组会显示在这里。: Its preview, notes, and groups will appear here.
颜色格式无效：RGB 分量需在 0–255，透明度需在 0–1。: Invalid color. RGB components must be 0–255 and alpha must be 0–1.
默认使用 ⌘F 聚焦搜索；再次使用会退出搜索输入。打开面板时默认不聚焦搜索。: ⌘F enters or exits search by default. Opening the panel does not focus search automatically.
默认使用空格打开当前项目；网页、代码和文件需要先在“打开方式”中完成配置。: Space opens the current item by default. Configure links, code, and files in Open With first.
默认忽略密码、钥匙串和隐藏剪贴板内容。: Passwords, Keychain entries, and hidden clipboard content are ignored by default.
默认每 1 秒检查一次，可调整为 0.5 秒或 0.1 秒。修改后会在下一轮检测: Checks once per second by default. Choose 0.5 or 0.1 seconds for faster checks; changes take effect on the next check. Pauses while asleep or locked.
默认采集所有网站。如需关闭某个网站，请在 Chrome 工具栏中打开 Paste: All websites are captured by default. To disable a website, open the Pasteory extension in Chrome’s toolbar.
Top K 在分组系数中的权重: Top K contribution to group activity
凭据仅保存在 macOS 钥匙串，不写入设置、日志或备份。本机无鉴权接口可以留空: Credentials are stored only in macOS Keychain and excluded from settings, logs and backups. Leave blank for a local API without authentication.
分析已暂停，可以继续上次任务: Analysis paused; you can resume this task
单位为 USD / 百万 tokens。留空时费用显示横线；订阅额度不换算成账单: USD per million tokens. Leave blank to hide estimated cost. Subscription quotas are not treated as bills. Prices are recorded per request.
压缩整理完成，回收原文载荷 {0}: Compression complete; {0} of raw payload reclaimed
压缩本组旧资料: Compress older items in this group
原子操作将统一提交，原文和用户备注保持不变。: Operations commit together. Original content and user notes are preserved.
原文已有变化，本归纳需要重新检查: Source content changed; review this summary again
只展示接口已声明的推理档位。未知或不支持时，自动模式不发送推理参数。: Only reasoning levels advertised by the API are shown. Auto omits the parameter when support is unknown.
可调整主题、组织方式与输出语言。原文保护、读取范围和原子能力由应用校验。: Customize topics, organization and response language. The app enforces content protection, reading scope and atomic operations.
同一材料在多个分组共享一份原文。压缩包持有可恢复副本；只有原文引用归零、压缩校验: Groups share one original payload. Compressed references retain a recoverable copy. Raw bytes are reclaimed only after verification and when no raw references remain.
启用后，允许的标题、正文片段、备注、来源与时间会发送到所选模型。通过本机 Mag: When enabled, permitted titles, content excerpts, notes, sources and dates are sent to the selected model. Local Magpie may forward requests to a cloud provider.
图片和文件仅发送元数据；逐条禁止 AI 的资料及已识别的密钥不参与分析。应用退出: Images and files send metadata only. Excluded items and recognized credentials are skipped. Scheduled tasks run while the app is open and awake.
定时检查变化: Check for changes on a schedule
按当前定义重新检查成员: Review members against the current definition
按最近复制时间取不同内容。全库任务也按批次处理，保存进度；不会一次发送整个资料库: Select distinct items by most recent capture. Library tasks run in bounded batches with saved progress.
摘要与无损载荷分别保存。元数据、搜索预览和其他分组关系保留，打开时按需恢复。: Summaries and lossless payloads are stored separately. Metadata, search previews and memberships remain available; content is restored on demand.
新分组、聚合和移出操作仍进入预览。用户的主题定义与手动成员受到保护。: New groups, aggregations and removals require review. User definitions and manual memberships are protected.
权重为 0 时关闭该指标，其余权重自动归一化。AI 更新概况、调整分组不刷新使用: Zero disables a metric; remaining weights are normalized. AI overview and membership updates do not refresh usage time.
标准策略为 7 / 14 / 60 天。时间节点不会自动删除资料，收藏和置顶继续: Standard uses 7 / 14 / 60 days. Time thresholds never delete content automatically. Favorites and pinned items remain protected.
概况仅覆盖部分资料或需要更新: Overview covers only part of the group or needs updating
模型、智能分组、生命周期与无损压缩: Models, AI grouping, lifecycle and lossless compression
模型连接和工具协议测试通过: Model connection and tool protocol verified
每次请求先预留预算。失败或超时的未知用量保守估算，不显示为零。: Budget is reserved before each request. Unknown usage after a failure or timeout is estimated conservatively.
没有可参与 AI 分析的内容: No eligible content for AI analysis
活跃、留存、归档由内容本身的使用记录计算。分组根据成员活跃系数汇总，不单独计时。: Active, retained and archived stages derive from each item's usage. Group activity is calculated from its members.
版本变化或引用失效时，整批停止并保留现有数据。: If versions or references change, the entire batch stops and existing data is preserved.
用户编辑的定义优先，AI 只维护成员和独立的内容概况。: Your definition takes precedence. AI maintains memberships and a separate overview.
禁止此内容参与 AI 分析: Exclude this item from AI analysis
缓存是输入子集，推理可能是输出子集，均不重复加总。混合计量包含服务商返回与本地估: Cached tokens are part of input; reasoning tokens may be part of output. Neither is counted twice. Totals combine provider usage and local estimates.
自动补充已有 AI 分组: Automatically append to existing AI groups
请先在 AI 整理设置中启用模型连接: Enable a model connection in AI settings first
连续复制等待 30 秒；累计 5 条或等待 2 分钟进入队列；自动分析至少间隔: Wait 30 seconds after copying stops. Queue after 5 items or 2 minutes. Automatic analysis runs at most once every 5 minutes.
